<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/openapi/reward/validateReward"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Evaluates whether a customer is eligible for reward redemption (loyalty points burn
or offer discount) against a specific order, and returns the exact discount breakdown.
Call this endpoint before finalising a transaction to compute the precise discount
amount and points to deduct. The response breaks down the discount at both the order
level and individual item level, enabling the POS to display a pre-discount summary.
This endpoint is read-only — it does not record any redemption. Always follow up with
`rewardRedeemed` after the transaction completes to commit the deduction.
